nom-llengua: The name of your language, written in your language and in lower case unless your language capitalizes language names (e.g. «galego», «euskara»). Shown in the language selector on the About page.

error-config:

tria-cerca: Button label: search places with the text typed in the search box.

tria-cap-resultat: Shown when the place search returns nothing. Suggests typing the name without the article (e.g. «Hospitalet» instead of «l'Hospitalet») or another name.
tria-n-resultats:

bloc-hores: Name and heading of the hourly forecast block (next 24 hours).
bloc-dies: Name and heading of the daily forecast block (next 10 days).

bloc-uv: Name and title of the ultraviolet index tile.

bloc-humitat: Name and title of the relative humidity tile.
bloc-pressio: Name and title of the atmospheric pressure tile.

personalitza-titol: Heading of the section of the settings page where the user chooses which blocks of the panel are shown and in which order.
configuracio-titol: Title of the settings page (and its options menu item and button at the bottom of the panel). The page has two sections: the language of the program and «Customize the panel» (which blocks are shown and in which order). Use the usual word for «Settings» in Windows or other software in your language.
personalitza-explicacio: Explanation at the top of the «Customize the panel» page. «Tiles» are the small square blocks shown two per row.
personalitza-amaga: Tooltip of the checkbox of a visible block: unchecking it hides the block.
personalitza-mostra: Tooltip of the checkbox of a hidden block: checking it shows the block.
personalitza-ample: Small note under a block name: this block takes the full width of the panel.
personalitza-petita: Small note under a block name: this block is a small tile (two per row).
personalitza-puja: Tooltip of the up-arrow button: moves the block one position up.
personalitza-baixa: Tooltip of the down-arrow button: moves the block one position down.
personalitza-arrossega: Tooltip of the drag handle (three horizontal lines) at the left of each block in the «Customize the panel» list: drag it up or down to change the order of the blocks.
personalitza-restableix: Button: shows all blocks again in the original order.
endreca-boto: Button at the bottom of the panel: enters the «arrange» mode, where the blocks of the panel can be dragged to change their order.
endreca-ajuda: Banner shown at the top of the panel in «arrange» mode: drag the blocks to change their order; the small tiles are placed automatically two per row.
endreca-fet: Button in the «arrange» mode banner: leave the arrange mode (done).
estat-0: Weather condition (WMO code 0): clear sky. Shown on the taskbar widget and at the top of the panel; keep it short.
estat-48: Weather condition (WMO code 48): depositing rime fog (freezing fog).
estat-56: Weather condition (WMO codes 56 and 57): freezing drizzle.
estat-66: Weather condition (WMO codes 66 and 67): freezing rain.
estat-71: Weather condition (WMO code 71): slight snow fall.
estat-73: Weather condition (WMO code 73): moderate snow fall.
estat-75: Weather condition (WMO code 75): heavy snow fall.
estat-80: Weather condition (WMO code 80): slight rain showers.
estat-81: Weather condition (WMO code 81): moderate rain showers.
estat-82: Weather condition (WMO code 82): violent rain showers.
estat-85: Weather condition (WMO codes 85 and 86): snow showers.
estat-96: Weather condition (WMO codes 96 and 99): thunderstorm with hail.
estat-desconegut: Shown when the weather service sends an unknown weather code.
dia-avui: Label of the first day in the 10-day forecast: today.
dia-dema: Label of the second day in the 10-day forecast: tomorrow.
dia-curt-0: Abbreviated day of the week: Sunday. Used in the 10-day forecast list; keep it very short (2-3 letters).
dia-curt-1: Abbreviated day of the week: Monday. Keep it very short.
dia-curt-2: Abbreviated day of the week: Tuesday. Keep it very short.
dia-curt-3: Abbreviated day of the week: Wednesday. Keep it very short.
dia-curt-4: Abbreviated day of the week: Thursday. Keep it very short.
dia-curt-5: Abbreviated day of the week: Friday. Keep it very short.
dia-curt-6: Abbreviated day of the week: Saturday. Keep it very short.
hora-ara: First column of the hourly forecast and of the sea forecast: now. Keep it very short.

resum-pluja-probable:
Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: rain is likely (50 % or more) at a given time.

Parameters:
* $1 - time of day, e.g. 17:00
resum-pluja-possible:
Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: a shower is possible (30 % or more) at a given time.

resum-temp-baixen-molt: Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: maximum temperatures will drop clearly (3 °C or more) in the next two days.
resum-temp-baixen: Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: slight drop of temperatures in the next two days.
resum-temp-pugen-molt: Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: maximum temperatures will rise clearly (3 °C or more) in the next two days.
resum-temp-pugen: Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: slight rise of temperatures in the next two days.
resum-temp-estables: Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: temperatures will stay stable in the next two days.
resum-ratxes:
Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: warning about strong wind gusts.

resum-uv-alt: Sentence of the «What's coming» summary: the UV index will be high around midday, protect yourself from the sun.
ica-0: Air quality category 1 of 6 of the official Spanish air quality index (ICA): good. It qualifies «air quality» (feminine in Catalan).
ica-1: Air quality category 2 of 6 (ICA): reasonably good.
ica-2: Air quality category 3 of 6 (ICA): fair / regular.
ica-4: Air quality category 5 of 6 (ICA): very unfavourable.
ica-5: Air quality category 6 of 6 (ICA): extremely unfavourable.
ica-pm25: Air pollutant name: fine particulate matter PM2.5.
ica-pm10: Air pollutant name: particulate matter PM10.
ica-detall:
One line of the air quality detail (tooltip).

* $2 - concentration (a number)

mar-douglas-0: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 0 (wave height under 0.05 m): calm (glassy). Use the official names of your national weather service if they exist.
mar-douglas-1: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 1 (up to 0.1 m): calm (rippled).
mar-douglas-2: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 2 (0.1 to 0.5 m): smooth (wavelets).
mar-douglas-3: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 3 (0.5 to 1.25 m): slight.
mar-douglas-4: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 4 (1.25 to 2.5 m): moderate.
mar-douglas-5: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 5 (2.5 to 4 m): rough.
mar-douglas-6: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 6 (4 to 6 m): very rough.
mar-douglas-7: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 7 (6 to 9 m): high.
mar-douglas-8: Sea state, Douglas scale degree 8 (over 9 m): very high / phenomenal.

platja-bandera-vermella: Colour of a beach flag: red (bathing forbidden). Lower case.

punt-4: Compass point abbreviation: east. Also shown inside the wind compass.
punt-8: Compass point abbreviation: south. Also shown inside the wind compass.

mar-temperatura: Sea block: small label under the sea water temperature value.

uv-4: UV index level (11 or more): extreme.

pluja-probabilitat-maxima:

humitat-rosada:
Humidity tile: dew point temperature.

pressio-baixa: Tooltip of the pressure tile when pressure is low (1005 hPa or less): unsettled weather.
pressio-normal: Tooltip of the pressure tile when pressure is normal.
giny-ajuda:
Tooltip of the widget on the taskbar.

sense-connexio: Shown on the taskbar widget when there is no internet connection. Keep it short.
ara-sensacio:
Top of the panel: «feels like» temperature.

ara-maxmin:
Top of the panel: today's maximum and minimum temperatures.

Top of the panel: time of the last data update.

lloc-ajuda: Tooltip of a saved place «pill» at the top of the panel: click to see its weather; drag it left or right to change the order (the first place is the main one, shown on the taskbar); right click for options.
lloc-principal: Tooltip of the star icon on the main place, the one shown on the taskbar.
lloc-fes-principal: Context menu item of a saved place: make it the main place (shown on the taskbar).
lloc-canvia-nom-menu: Context menu item of a saved place: rename it (opens a dialog).

lloc-mou-dreta: Context menu item of a saved place: move it one position to the right.
lloc-treu: Context menu item of a saved place: remove it from the list.
lloc-afegeix-ajuda: Tooltip of the «Add» pill: add a new place.
lloc-afegeix: Label of the pill that adds a new place. Keep it short.
tema-auto: Tooltip of a button: use the same light or dark mode as Windows.
tema-clar: Tooltip of a button: light mode.
tema-fosc: Tooltip of a button: dark mode.
actualitza-ara: Tooltip of the refresh button: download the weather data again now.
boto-meteocat: Button at the bottom of the panel (only for places in Catalonia): opens the official forecast of the Meteorological Service of Catalonia. Meteocat is a proper name.
bloc-mar: Heading of the sea block (only for coastal places) and title of its detail page.
radar-titol: Heading of the rain radar block: animated radar images of the last 2 hours.
radar-obre: Tooltip of the radar map: click to open a bigger radar map in the web browser.
radar-carregant: Shown on the radar map while it is loading.
radar-credits: Credits on the radar map. Required attribution: translate «OpenStreetMap contributors» as OpenStreetMap does in your language; RainViewer is a proper name.
torna: Tooltip of the back arrow on detail pages: go back to the panel.
giny-carregant: Shown on the taskbar widget while the first data is loading. Keep it short.
grafic-anteriors: Tooltip of the left arrow of an hourly chart: scroll to earlier hours.
grafic-seguents: Tooltip of the right arrow of an hourly chart: scroll to later hours.
ara-mateix: Small label above a big value on a detail page: right now.
ara-mateix-titol: Bold label at the start of a paragraph that describes the current situation (wind, sea). Keep the colon if your language uses it.
maxima-resta-dia: Small label above a big value on a detail page (wind, UV index): highest value for the rest of today.
font-titol: Bold label at the start of the paragraph that explains where the data comes from.
pluja-total-previst: Precipitation page: label above the total precipitation forecast for today.
pluja-idea-titol: Precipitation page: bold label «To get an idea:».
pluja-idea: Precipitation page: what the amounts in mm mean. Follows the bold label «To get an idea:», so it starts in lower case in Catalan.
vent-ratxes-de:

vent-desc-3: Wind page: description of the current wind, 39 to 62 km/h (strong).
vent-desc-4: Wind page: description of the current wind, 62 km/h or more (very strong, dangerous).
vent-ara:
Wind page: current wind, after the bold label «Right now:».

vent-velocitat: Wind page: what the wind speed means. Uses the abbreviation for northwest of your language (see punt-14).
sol-alba: Sun page: label of the dawn time (civil twilight starts).
sol-sortida: Sun page: label of the sunrise time.
sol-posta: Sun page: label of the sunset time.
sol-capvespre: Sun page: label of the dusk time (civil twilight ends).

uv-0-consell: UV index page: advice for low UV.
uv-1-titol: UV index page: bold label of the advice for moderate UV (3 to 5).
uv-1-consell: UV index page: advice for moderate UV.
uv-2-titol: UV index page: bold label of the advice for high UV (6 to 7).
uv-2-consell: UV index page: advice for high UV.
uv-3-titol: UV index page: bold label of the advice for very high to extreme UV (8 or more).
uv-3-consell: UV index page: advice for very high or extreme UV.
